summary: Both problems are fully transcribed with correct tables, quantities, LaTeX and attached official solutions; the four figure crops each contain the whole intended drawing without clipping body text. The missing solar-disk negatives are correctly flagged as a caveat, not silently repaired.

defects.description: The three negative solar-disk images referenced in Problem 1 are indeed absent from the printed problems document (page 1 contains only text); the candidate correctly preserves the statement and notes the absence rather than inventing figures.

Crop p1-sol-fig1 [332,212,694,572] contains the complete cross-section diagram: circle, chord A-B-C-O, points S/F1/F2, angle labels φ0/φ1/φ2/Δφ and the 'Към наблюдателя' arrow with caption; nothing clipped, no body text swallowed.
Crop p2-fig1 contains all ten observer points (1–10) with labels, the N/E/S/W compass and the '100 км' scale bar; no clipping and no swallowed table text.

Crop p2-sol-fig1 reproduces the observer scheme as printed on solutions page 4; the candidate's alt text honestly notes the shadow-direction arrow is not visible in the reproduction — matching the printed page, not a transcription defect.
Crop p2-sol-fig2 [605,290,970,535] shows the reconstructed rabbit-shaped profile with chords, observer points, compass and scale bar; complete and unclipped.
